name: Exploratory: Smoke: open page and wait
description: The assessment of 'Access Denied' (https://www.tui.nl/?utm_source=admarketplace&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=regular&utm_content=355252386799812608&mfadid=adm) found no visible interactive controls (buttons, links, inputs, or selects). This smoke case still opens the page, waits for settle time, and confirms the document remains responsive — useful for detecting hard load failures or blank-page crashes.
